mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.uuid, m.code, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.module_id, m.web_url, m.app_url, m.icon, m.sort, m.status FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.status = 1 AND ( (p.person_type = 2 AND p.user_id = u.uuid) OR (p.person_type = 1 AND p.role_id = u.role_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role r WHERE r.uuid = u.role_id AND r.status = 1 )) ) INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.uuid = p.menu_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE u.uuid = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.uuid ASC
